question_en: Statement/ Should sex determination test during pregnancy be completely banned? Arguments/ I. Yes, this leads to indiscriminate female foeticide & eventually will lead to social imbalance. II. No, people have a right to know about the sex of their unborn child.
option_a: Only argument I is strong./ I
